heading: Monday, January 19, 2026
topLine: Thomas Bloom calls AI tools 'invaluable' for Erdős problems but novelty 'ill-defined'.

items.headline: Thomas Bloom calls AI tools 'invaluable' for Erdős problems but novelty 'ill-defined'
items.summary: In a retrospective on erdosproblems.com, Bloom wrote that AI became useful from October 2025 as a "super-powered literature search" and that AI-generated solutions had begun arriving in the previous month. He said picking off low-hanging fruit is being automated, that whether an AI solution is new is often unclear, and that he was unsure how soon AI would help with the hardest problems.
